title: Staining of Survival Motor Neuron Protein in PBMCs

steps.title: Block PBMCs
steps.instruction: Block the whole blood sample using normal human Ig solution.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 1.5 mL of heparin-treated whole blood into a 15 mL conical tube.
Add 30 μL of normal human Ig solution (Clear Back, MTG-001, MBL, Nagoya, Japan).
Gently shake and leave in the dark at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Surface Stain PBMCs
steps.instruction: Stain the cells with surface marker antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 μL each of PE-HIB19, PE-Cy5-WM53, and BV610-UCHT1 (Biolegend).
Gently shake and leave in the dark at room temperature for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Lysis and Fixation
steps.instruction: Perform lysis and fixation of the cells at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Warm lysis/fixation buffer and PBS (-) to 37 °C in a water bath.
Add 10 mL of pre-warmed lysis/fixation buffer (37 ºC) and mix immediately by inverting.
Incubate in a water bath at 37 °C for 10 minutes.
Mix by inverting and centrifuge at 900 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard the supernatant using an aspirator.

steps.title: Wash Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells with pre-warmed PBS.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in PBS (-) (37 °C).
Centrifuge at 900 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.

steps.title: Permeabilize Cells
steps.instruction: Permeabilize the cells using permeabilization buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend with 1.5 mL of permeabilization buffer.
Incubate at room temperature in the dark for 30 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Resuspend again with 1.5 mL of permeabilization buffer.
Centrifuge at 900 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.

steps.title: Intracellular Staining
steps.instruction: Stain for SMN protein and isotype control.

substeps.instruction: Perform cell count.
Dispense 1 x 10^6 cells in 50 μL of Permeabilization buffer into two microcentrifuge tubes (one for specific Ab and one for isotype control).
To the SMN staining tube, add 1 μg of AF488-2B1.
To the isotype control tube, add 1 test of AF488-MOPC21 (5 μL).
Incubate both tubes at room temperature in the dark for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Wash After Intracellular Staining
steps.instruction: Wash the stained cells to remove unbound antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of permeabilization buffer and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes.
Repeat the wash step twice more and discard the final supernatant.

steps.title: Nuclear Staining and Final Wash
steps.instruction: Stain nuclei with Hoechst 33342 and prepare for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Suspend in 50 μL of Hoechst 33342 (final concentration: 0.25 μg/mL).
Incubate in the dark at room temperature for 15 minutes.
Add 500 μL of PBS (-) and centrifuge at 500 × g for 5 minutes.
Discard supernatant.
Suspend with 50 μL of PBS (-) for analysis.
